body: This sentence is missing the final noun, which makes the Limit section read a bit incomplete. Consider explicitly saying what SQLite artifact the remotes cannot see (e.g., the store/database).

The doc comment for `usablePathOverride` is written as if it only exists for `CAIRN_HOME`, but the helper is also applied to `CAIRN_DB_PATH`. Either update the comment to cover both variables or apply the helper only to `CAIRN_HOME` to avoid confusing future maintainers about the intended behavior change.
